output.response_text:
Dear Enterprise Client 3,

Thank you for bringing the intermittent 500 Internal Server Error you are seeing on your API webhook to our attention. We understand how critical reliable webhook delivery is for your operations, and we apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

To investigate the root cause and work toward a resolution, we kindly ask you to provide the following information:

- The exact timestamps (including time zone) of the failed webhook calls.
- The request IDs associated with each failed call, if available.
- Sample payloads from the failed requests.
- Confirmation of any recent changes to the webhook endpoint URL, payload schema, or deployment versions on your side.
- Any relevant logs or error messages you have captured from your endpoint during the failure windows.

Once we receive this data, our team will:
1. Correlate your information with our internal logs and metrics.
2. Perform a health check of the webhook processing pipeline.
3. Identify any transient downstream failures and apply any necessary configuration adjustments.
4. Keep you updated on our progress at least every 2 business hours.

If the investigation indicates that a code change or deeper platform issue is involved, we will promptly escalate the case to our Platform Reliability Engineering team.

We appreciate your cooperation and will work diligently to restore full webhook reliability.

Best regards,
Enterprise API Support Team
